name: agent-safeguards
description: Shell-command guardrails for Claude Code and Codex: keeps identity and credential output out of the transcript and blocks deletes that could wipe a drive.

interface.shortDescription: Shell guardrails for identity output and destructive deletes
interface.longDescription: Checks every shell command before it runs and its output after. safe-tool blocks commands that print identity or credential data and withholds output that contains it. delete-guard blocks recursive deletes outside the current repository and temp folders. Local, no network, no telemetry.
